articles.title: 'No, not really': Marcus Trescothick unsure of future with England Test side
articles.summary: Cricket News: Marcus Trescothick is not sure if he will continue with England's Test team after Stephen Fleming takes charge as the permanent head coach.Trescothick.
articles.body: Marcus Trescothick is not sure if he will continue with England's Test team after Stephen Fleming takes charge as the permanent head coach.Trescothick was the interim head coach during England's recent 3-0 home series win over Pakistan. He took charge after Brendon McCullum left the Test coaching role, with Fleming set to take over ahead of the winter series against South Africa.Trescothick had worked as McCullum's assistant coach and is now waiting to find out whether he will remain part of the Test coaching staff under Fleming.Trescothick unsure about Test roleWhen asked if he knew what his Test role would be once Fleming takes over, Trescothick admitted that there was no clear answer yet."No, not really," Trescothick said when asked whether he had an idea of his Test role in the future, as quoted by Cricinfo. "I've spoken with Rob Key a little bit over the last couple of weeks and had bits of discussions on what might happen."I think when Stephen’s (Fleming) over and then they - Rob and Stephen and Brendon - can get together and really sort of thrash out exactly how it's going to look, then we'll probably be involved in those sort of conversations afterwards."Trescothick joins England's white-ball setupTrescothick will now travel to Southampton to join McCullum and the England white-ball team for the Sri Lanka T20I series. He will be joined by fellow assistants Sarah Taylor, Tim Southee and Jeetan Patel. Kevin Pietersen will also join the group as a specialist mentor."Our immediate plan is obviously then looking at the Sri Lanka series we're now straight into, with the possibility of going maybe into Pakistan. But I think within the next couple of weeks we'll know a bit more."I love doing both formats. It's been brilliant and (I'm) privileged to be in the position of being assistant coach where you're on the road because it's great fun and you're with the team and you're working with the best. There's nothing better than working with your own national country, of course. But we'll see. We'll see how it pans out."Joe Root praises TrescothickEngland Test captain Joe Root praised Trescothick for the way he handled the team during the Pakistan series."I think the way that he's worked with me, the way that he's worked with the group, has been outstanding," Root said. "And I hope he takes a lot of confidence from it and if he ever gets the opportunity to be a head coach further down the line, it's been great for him and he's done a brilliant job over the course of the three games."Trescothick wants England voice in Test setupTrescothick also stressed the importance of having people in the Test coaching staff who understand the specific needs of English players and the England team."As much as we can within the course of coaching systems, you want someone within that that can highlight things that are important with England players and England teams and England series that you play," said Trescothick. "Because they are different to other countries and unique in their own way."We want to try and promote our own from within and get them up to the top because there's nothing better, I don't think, than if you can get to that point. It's not the be all and end all. But, I think, as much as we can have the representation in there, then the better it'll be."Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Why is Vaibhav Sooryavanshi not playing vs Afghanistan in 1st T20I?
articles.summary: Cricket News: NEW DELHI: India made a big selection call for the first T20I against Afghanistan at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi on Sunday, with Sanju Samson ge.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: India made a big selection call for the first T20I against Afghanistan at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in Delhi on Sunday, with Sanju Samson getting the nod over young batting sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.Captain Shreyas Iyer won the toss and decided to bowl first. India also brought Jasprit Bumrah back into the playing XI and picked specialist spinner Varun Chakaravarthy ahead of Yash Thakur.Why is Vaibhav Sooryavanshi not playing?India chose experience in the opening game, with Samson selected in the XI instead of Vaibhav.Iyer also confirmed that Washington Sundar and two other players were left out, making it clear that team combination was behind the decision."It's a luxury to have him (Bumrah) in the squad -- he carries lot of great attitude when it comes to winning matches. Vaibhav (Sooryavanshi) is not playing, neither are Washington and two more."Iyer later explained that managing the team combination was difficult."That is more difficult, I feel, but I would say if Vaibhav (Sooryavanshi) is not playing, then Washington (Sundar) is not playing and there are two more which you'll get to know".Samson was named as India's wicketkeeper, with Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer and Tilak Varma also in the batting group.India also picked Nitish Kumar Reddy, Shivam Dube and Axar Patel before going with Arshdeep Singh, Bumrah and Varun Chakaravarthy as the bowling options.Iyer said India had played several matches in Delhi and wanted to make use of the conditions by bowling first."We’re going to bowl first. I mean, when you have played in Delhi, you know what the pitch has got to offer and we’ve played quite a bit of matches over here. So based on that and looking at the conditions, that’s really both. [On his first ten matches as India captain]It's been a roller coaster ride, but if you see the previous series which we played against Zimbabwe, there were a lot of positives and the boys were optimistic in their approach. So, that's the attitude we've got to carry in this series as well."Jasprit Bumrah returnsBumrah returned to the India XI after missing recent assignments following the left-knee injury that ruled him out of an ODI in England and two Tests in Sri Lanka.Iyer called having Bumrah in the squad a "luxury" and highlighted his experience and ability to win matches."[On having Jasprit Bumrah available in the squad] Yes, certainly. I think it's a luxury to have him in the squad because he's immensely experienced and he carries a lot of great attitude when it comes to winning matches. So, we know he's a match winner and we know what he's got to offer."Afghanistan make changesAfghanistan captain Ibrahim Zadran said his team would have bowled first had they won the toss."We would have bowled first. Unfortunately, we lost the toss and we will think about batting. We will try to put a good total on the board."Zadran said Afghanistan were excited to host India and asked fans to support both teams."Yeah, it's a great feeling for us. It is a pleasure to host India, here in India for the first time. We are trying to enjoy ourselves, trying to have a good series against them."He added: "We have got lots of support from the fans in the past as well, and just requesting them to come support, both teams. I hope they don't forget us, but hopefully they come and support their own player, their own team, and give their energy to the players."Afghanistan also made changes to their side."Naveen(-ul-Haq) is not playing, Noor Ahmad, and Abdullah (Ahmadzai) and Naveen-ul-Haq, he's not match ready for today. Yeah, we will think about him for the second and third game," Afghanistan captain Ibrahim Zadran said.India vs Afghanistan 1st T20I: Playing XIsAfghanistan: Ibrahim Zadran (c), Rahmanullah Gurbaz (wk), Sediqullah Atal, Darwish Rasooli, Azmatullah Omarzai, Gulbadin Naib, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Noor Ahmad, Fazalhaq FarooqiIndia: Sanju Samson (wk), Abhishek Sharma, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer (c), Tilak Varma, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Shivam Dube, Axar Patel, Arshdeep Singh, Jasprit Bumrah, Varun ChakaravarthyGet the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: India alter winning combination for Asia Cup final vs Sri Lanka; Gunalan Kamalini replaces Pratika Rawal
articles.summary: Cricket News: India captain Harmanpreet Kaur won the toss and elected to bat first against Sri Lanka in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final at the Dubai International C.
articles.body: India captain Harmanpreet Kaur won the toss and elected to bat first against Sri Lanka in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium on Sunday.India have made their first change of the tournament, bringing Gunalan Kamalini into the playing XI in place of Pratika Rawal. Kamalini gets her first opportunity in this edition of the Asia Cup and will play only her second T20I for India.The change comes after India fielded an unchanged XI in their opening four matches.India aim for record eighth Asia Cup titleBoth India and Sri Lanka have remained unbeaten on their way to the final, although India have looked the more dominant side throughout the tournament. The Women in Blue have produced strong performances across batting, bowling and fielding, with Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma leading the run-scoring charts for India.With the ball, Deepti Sharma and Shree Charani have been among India's standout performers, claiming 11 and eight wickets respectively. India are chasing a record-extending eighth Asia Cup title, having previously won four editions in the ODI format and three in T20Is.Sri Lanka rely on Athapaththu and DilhariSri Lanka have also reached the final unbeaten but have not been as consistent with the bat. Captain Chamari Athapaththu has managed just 63 runs from four innings, and Sri Lanka will need their top order to step up against India's strong bowling attack.Kavisha Dilhari has emerged as another key player for the defending champions and will be expected to contribute with both bat and ball in the title clash.India Women Playing XI: Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Gunalan Kamalini, Harmanpreet Kaur (c), Bharti Fulmali, Richa Ghosh (wk), Deepti Sharma, Prema Rawat, Shree Charani, Kranti Gaud, Nandani SharmaSri Lanka Women Playing XI: Chamari Athapaththu (c), Imesha Dulani, Vishmi Gunaratne, Hasini Perera, Harshitha Samarawickrama, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshika Silva, Kaushani Nuthyangana (wk), Sugandika Kumari, Chamudi Praboda, Mithali AyodhyaGet the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: After IND vs AFG first, ‘Vande Mataram’ set to become regular before India matches
articles.summary: Cricket News: New Delhi: For the first time ever, the national song, 'Vande Mataram', was sung before the match between India and Afghanistan at the Arun Jaitley St.
articles.body: New Delhi: For the first time ever, the national song, 'Vande Mataram', was sung before the match between India and Afghanistan at the Arun Jaitley Stadium in New Delhi on Sunday. The national song was followed by the standard practice of national anthems of both countries.It must be mentioned here that 'Vande Mataram' was sung during the Delhi Premier League final also, which also took place at the same venue. Curiously, it was not played during other state leagues in Odisha and Punjab.It has been learnt that it is going to be a practice going forward in matches involving the Indian team in India. "This is going to be followed in all events in India going forward. It is going to be a practice and it is not just about this stadium," said a source.It comes on the heels of Parliament passing a bill that made any insult to the national song a punishable offence. The full official version of ‘Vande Mataram’ comprises six stanzas - which was sung before the first of the three match series.As the 150th anniversary of 'Vande Mataram' was celebrated, the Home Ministry had directed that all six stanzas must be sung when 'Jana Gana Mana' is also sung."The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026 amends Section 3 of the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971. It extends the same legal protection to the National Song, Vande Mataram that is currently afforded to the National Anthem, Jana Gana Mana. The amendment makes it an offence to intentionally prevent the singing of the National Song or to cause a disturbance to an assembly engaged in its singing," said a PIB statement in July.Prior to the teams taking the field for the national song and anthems, India skipper Shreyas Iyer had won the toss and chosen to field.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
